summary: Whirlpool filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, announcing the pricing of a private offering of $1.0 billion in 7.500% Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2031 and $1.0 billion in 7.875% Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2034. The notes were sold in a private placement under Rule 144A and Regulation S, and are not registered under the Securities Act. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved; this is a routine debt issuance. The filing includes a press release as an exhibit.
